name: codex-temporary-companion
description: Persistent Temporary Chat controls, compatible Codex patch repair, and a temporary terminal client.

commands.title: Temporary Chat: Restore Original Codex Files

temporaryCompanion.autoRepair.description: Repair compatible Codex updates after a previous explicit patch installation. Unknown layouts are left untouched. Reload VS Code after a repair.

temporaryCompanion.nodePath.description: Optional absolute path to Node.js 22.13 or newer for the bundled temporary terminal client. Otherwise use Node.js from PATH.
